name: 100 Fantasy Dungeon Assets
description: 100 chunky low-poly assets to build RPG dungeons, crypts and caves, true to scale for a 5-stud character on one grid: floor tiles are 12 x 12 studs, walls are 12 wide, 12 tall and 2 thick, doorways are 6 wide and 8 tall. Modular kit (floors, walls, corner, door arch, barred window, pillars, archway, stairs, spiral stair, bridge, pit edge, ceiling), doors and gates, traps, lighting, chests in 5 tiers and a mimic, loot, furniture, statues, magic props and cave pieces. 1 Blender unit = 1 stud. Doors, gates, lids, traps, the lever, the portal and every flame have bones and actions. Textured, rigged and animated.

name: 100 Horror Game Props
description: 100 chunky low-poly props for horror games, true to scale for a 5-stud character: from a 0.9-stud battery to a 16-stud abandoned car and a 14-stud dead tree. Abandoned house, asylum and hospital, backrooms-style office, basement and utility rooms, a spooky yard and gameplay pick-ups (flashlight, keys, fuses, medkit, hiding locker, safe). Spooky and worn, not gory. 1 Blender unit = 1 stud: doors clear 7.5 studs. Doors, gates, lids, the elevator, the rocking chair, hanging lights, chains and swings have bones and actions; every wheel is its own part. Textured, rigged and animated.

name: 100 Tropical Island Assets
description: 100 chunky low-poly tropical island assets, true to scale for a 5-stud character, to build beaches, islands and resorts: palms, tropical plants, rocks, shells and coral, beach gear, lifeguard tower, huts, tiki bar and tiki statues, bungalow on stilts, boardwalks, pier and dock, boats, a beach buggy and a golf cart, plus a volcano, waterfall, cave and shipwreck. 1 Blender unit = 1 stud. Every wheel is its own part; doors, lids, sails, the hammock, the propeller and flames have bones and actions. Textured, rigged and animated.

name: 100 Medieval Village Assets
description: 100 chunky low-poly assets to build a medieval village and castle, true to scale for a 5-stud character: from a 1-stud tankard to a 40-stud castle keep. Cottages, tavern, chapel, windmill, water mill, barn, a modular castle kit (walls 14 studs high, towers, gatehouse with portcullis, drawbridge, stairs), market stalls, carts and wagons, workshop and interior props, siege engines, fences, bridge, dock and rowboat. 1 Blender unit = 1 stud: doors are 3.4 x 6.8 studs, tables 3 high. Every cart wheel is its own part; doors, gates, sails, water wheel and siege engines have bones and actions. Textured, rigged and animated.

name: 100 Candy Land Assets
description: 100 chunky low-poly candy world assets for simulator zones, obbies and tycoon maps, true to scale for a 5-stud character: from a 2-stud candy flower to a 60-stud ice cream mountain. Lollipop, candy cane and cotton candy trees, gumdrop hills, chocolate rocks, marshmallow boulders, sugar crystals, frosting clouds, gingerbread house, cupcake house, ice cream shop, candy tower, chocolate fountain, gumball machine tower, wafer walls, waffle bridge, peppermint, cookie, donut and macaron platforms, chocolate river, syrup waterfall, rainbow road, candy train and props. 1 Blender unit = 1 stud. Every wheel is its own part; the gate, chest, portal, fountain and gumball crank have bones. Textured, rigged and animated.

name: 100 Cute Farm Assets
description: 100 cute, rounded low-poly farm assets for farming games, true to scale for a 5-stud character: from a 1-stud strawberry to a 40-stud barn. Nine crops in three growth stages (Baby = seedling, Young = growing, Ripe): wheat, corn, sunflower, carrot, potato, cabbage, tomato, pumpkin, strawberry. Harvested produce, crates, baskets and sacks, soil plots (dry, tilled, watered), raised bed, scarecrow, compost bin, barn, silo, chicken coop, stable, greenhouse, windmill, water tower, tool shed, farm stand, well, dog house, fences, gate, hay bales, trough, feeder, beehive, water pump, tractor, trailer, combine harvester, pickup, wheelbarrow, hand cart, tools, fruit trees, berry bush, pond and flowers. 1 Blender unit = 1 stud. Every wheel is its own part; windmill blades, barn doors, gate and pump handle have bones. Textured, rigged and animated.

name: 100 Obby Parts
description: 100 bright, chunky low-poly obby parts, true to scale for a 5-stud character: everything an obstacle course needs. Platforms, moving platform, conveyor, ice and fading tiles, bounce pads and trampoline, lava, acid, spikes, saw blade, lasers, crusher, swinging hammer, axe and wrecking ball, spinning bar, truss, ropes, monkey bars, zipline, balloons, clouds, checkpoints, spawn and win pads, start gate, finish arch, podium, buttons, lever, key door, timed door, teleporter, portal, cannon launcher, speed, jump and gravity pads, coins, stars, gems, keys, hearts and decoration. 1 Blender unit = 1 stud. Moving hazards, doors, lever and cannon have bones and looping actions. Textured, rigged and animated.

name: 100 City Street Props
description: 100 chunky low-poly props to dress a city map, true to scale for a 5-stud character: from a 2-stud road cone to a 35-stud city bus. Traffic and pedestrian lights, street lamps, blank road signs, cones, barriers, bollards, benches, bins, hydrant, mailbox, phone booth, bus stop, hot dog and ice cream carts, food truck, newsstand, vending machine, ATM, market stall, power pole, water tower, billboard, dumpster, fountain, playground, gazebo, subway entrance, bus, taxi, scooter, bicycle, scaffold, cement mixer and more. 1 Blender unit = 1 stud. Every wheel is its own part; swings, seesaw, barrier arm, doors, lids and the fountain have bones. No text and no brands on any model. Textured, rigged and animated.

name: 150 Military Assets
description: 150 chunky low-poly military assets, true to scale for a 5-stud character: from a 0.6-stud bullet to an 80-stud cargo plane. Sandbags, barriers, trenches, bunkers, towers, hangar, tents, crates, radar, artillery, projectiles, tanks, trucks, helicopters, jets and boats. 1 Blender unit = 1 stud: hand-held gear is 0.6 to 3.5 studs, cover is chest high, doors and decks clear 7 studs, vehicles are 12 to 37 long. Every wheel is its own part, weapons have Turret / Barrel / Muzzle bones. Textured, rigged and animated.

name: 100 Prison Assets
description: 100 chunky low-poly prison assets for jailbreak and escape games, true to scale for a 5-stud character: from a 0.8-stud key to a 30-stud prison bus and a 35-stud guard tower. Police car, SUV, prison van, bus, armoured truck, motorbike and helicopter, cells with sliding bar doors, bunks, walls, fences, gates, guard tower, yard, cafeteria, laundry, workshop, offices, security gear and escape tools. 1 Blender unit = 1 stud: cells are 12 x 10 x 10, doors clear 7.5 studs. Every wheel is its own part; doors, gates, barrier, searchlight and camera have bones. Textured, rigged and animated.

name: 100 Simulator Essentials
description: 100 chunky low-poly props for simulator games: pet eggs, hatching stands, coins and gems, breakables, gates, portals and islands, shop and upgrade stations, boosts and rewards. Textured, rigged and animated.

name: 100 Christmas Decorations
description: 100 chunky low-poly Christmas and winter decorations: snowy pines and decorated trees, presents, candy canes and gingerbread, snowmen and snow forts, ice, ornaments, lights and village props. Textured, rigged and animated.

name: 100 Spooky Tools
description: 100 chunky low-poly Halloween tools for simulator and survival games: axes, pickaxes, hammers, shovels, swords, scythes, staffs and pitchforks in upgrade tiers from wood and bone to pumpkin, bat, slime, skull and cursed. Textured, rigged and animated.

name: 100 Halloween Decorations
description: 100 chunky cute-spooky Halloween map decorations: dead trees, pumpkins and jack-o-lanterns, gravestones and crypts, fences and gates, candles and lanterns, witch props, bones and decor. Textured, rigged and animated.

name: 100 Cute Guns
description: 100 cute, chubby toy blasters: pistols, SMGs, rifles, shotguns, snipers, launchers, ray guns and novelty guns in pastel and candy colours. Textured, rigged and animated.

name: 100 Wild West Decorations
description: 100 chunky low-poly Wild West map decorations: cacti, tumbleweeds, dead trees, desert rocks and mesas, town props, ranch fences and wagons, mine carts and rails, and camp gear. Textured, rigged and animated.

name: 100 Cute Furniture
description: 100 cute rounded low-poly furniture pieces in pastel colours for roleplay, housing and tycoon games: living room, bedroom, kitchen, bathroom, office, kids and gaming, decor and outdoor. Textured, rigged and animated.

name: 100 Cute Tycoon Assets
description: 100 cute rounded pastel tycoon assets: droppers in ten tiers, conveyors and pipes, upgraders, furnaces and machines, cash, coins, gold and safes, crates and ores, walls, doors, floors and stairs, decor, buttons, pads, trophies and a teleporter. Textured, rigged and animated.

name: 1000 Cute Pets
description: 1000 cute round pets and animals with happy, neutral and angry faces. Cats, dogs, farm, forest, safari, birds, reptiles, sea creatures, bugs and mythical beasts. Textured, rigged and animated.

name: 250 Cute Sea Creatures
description: 250 cute low-poly sea creatures: fish, sharks, whales, dolphins, crabs, lobsters, octopuses, squid, jellyfish and more. They swim, blink and bite. Textured, rigged and animated.

name: 100 RPG Items
description: 100 chunky low-poly RPG and survival items: tools, weapons, armour, gear, food, resources, crafting stations and economy props. Textured, rigged and animated.

name: 100 Cute Cars
description: 100 low-poly cartoon cars: compacts, sedans, sports cars, utility vehicles, service vehicles, fun vehicles, heavy trucks and vintage cars. Wheels are separate bones that spin, tyres have a black outline, no interiors. Textured, rigged and animated.

name: 100 Cute Foliage
description: 100 cute low-poly terrain decorations: trees, pines, bushes, grass, flowers, mushrooms, rocks, fallen logs and stumps. Textured, rigged and animated.

name: 100 Pirate Assets
description: 100 chunky low-poly pirate assets: characters, creatures, weapons, treasure, ship parts and island props. Textured, rigged and animated.

name: 100 Magic & Treasure Items
description: 100 chunky low-poly potions, gems, crystals, magic items, jewelry and treasure. Textured, rigged and animated.

name: 50 Low Poly Guns
description: 50 chunky low-poly guns and firearms. Textured, rigged and animated.

name: 100 Cute Fruits
description: 100 cute low-poly fruits with blinking faces and a soft glowing outline. Every fruit has an idle wiggle and a blink.

name: 100 RPG Enemies
description: 100 chunky low-poly RPG enemies: cute slimes, big angry slimes, skeletons, undead, goblins and orcs, golems, dragons, beasts and dark forces. Textured, rigged and animated.
